name: Intro
_source: s;Shen;Hey, can someone remind me...|{c:e;Shen;CloseEyes}{c:bop;Shen;no_block}What can we possibly be looking for in an abandoned town like this?
s;Andy;Throw in the towel already?{c:wait;400} You are softer than you look, kid.
s;Fuuko;I'm sorry to ask so much of you two right off the gate.{c:wait;400} But the UNION is lacking manpower.|Having your combat prowess is great assurance to our Quest.
s;Mui;You mentioned before that meeting us was your mission as well.|Are your Quests looking for new negators?
s;Andy;Quite close, but no.{w} This time, what we are looking for isn't human, instead...
s;Gunpowder;Hold ya horses right there, partners!;0,24
s;Gunpowder;Ya done crossed the territory of this good ol' me.|Be wise and leave ya gold behind, then I reckon I will let ya ride easy with ya life.
s;Shen;Whoa! A talking yoaguai?{w} I wonder if my punches work on them.
s;Fuuko;It's an UMA, creatures created by God to impose sufferings on human.|And this one is responsible for all those senseless gun shootings recently.
s;Gunpowder;Ah, educated, ain't ya? Well, having brains do ya no good around these parts.|This town is completely run by ma horde of wights, ya see.|Blame ya luck that ya have to cross paths with us.

s;Fuuko;Well, I have never been a lucky person, but it's fortunate that we're able to find you.|You see, our Quest this time calls for the elimination of UMA Gunpowder,|and we have been running close to the deadline.
s;Gunpowder;Ya...Ya must be the UNION!{w} Apocalypse put a hit on me? That dratted book!|That's sealed it. Ain't none of y'all shall leave here alive.
